body.name: Mock APIs
body.description: Free REST APIs for learning, building, and testing. No API key required.

resources.name: users
resources.description: Fictional user profiles with contact details, address, company, and role. Users own posts, todos, comments, carts, and recipes.

resources.name: products
resources.description: A fictional product catalog across categories with pricing, discounts, ratings, and stock levels.

resources.name: posts
resources.description: Short blog-style posts written by seeded users, with tags, reactions, and view counts.

resources.name: comments
resources.description: Comments left by users on posts. Every comment references an existing post and user.

resources.name: todos
resources.description: Simple to-do items that belong to users. Ideal for practicing list rendering and toggling state.

resources.name: carts
resources.description: Shopping carts that reference seeded users and products, with computed totals and discounts.

resources.name: recipes
resources.description: Recipes with ingredients, step-by-step instructions, timings, and nutrition information.

resources.name: quotes
resources.description: Original, fictional quotes with fictional authors. Read-only.

recipes.name: Classic Margherita Pizza
instructions: Preheat the oven to its highest setting with a tray or pizza stone inside.
Stretch the pizza dough into a thin round on a floured surface.
Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce and tear the mozzarella over the top.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until the crust is blistered and the cheese is bubbling.
Finish with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the spaghetti until al dente, then reserve a cup of the cooking water.
Meanwhile, gently cook the remaining ingredients in olive oil over medium heat.
Toss the drained spaghetti with the sauce, adding cooking water as needed.
Serve immediately, topped with parmesan.
